key_insight: HARGO improves RL post-training for LLMs on HPC by adapting reward optimization to heterogeneous task behavior instead of using one uniform weighting scheme.
engineering_relevance: For HPC workflows that mix classification, factual QA, and generation, HARGO offers a practical alignment method that better matches model behavior to task-specific requirements.
method: Computes a group-level discrimination signal from reward contrast.
Uses reference-model log-probabilities to estimate confidence.
Combines both signals to modulate advantages and derive per-response weights without task labels.
evidence_signal: Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieved the best reported primary metrics: WinRate 54.62%, Data Race F1 91.30%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558.
watch_item: The method adds extra reward/weighting logic, so performance and stability may depend on how well confidence and reward signals are calibrated across very different task types.
paper_title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
